name: Autumn_Bun (she/her)
bio:
Autumn_Bun is the Designer on Silver Springs Survival. Jake first introduced her to the server, and she stayed because of the community and the friends she made along the way.

These days, Autumn_Bun especially enjoys seeing how players respond to the expansions she helps create. One of her favorite memories is watching the community theorize together in-game and on Discord during the most recent expansion.

Her favorite projects are the Silver Scepter mage college and the Arcanum. Outside of Silver Springs, Autumn is a huge space nerd who enjoys Outer Wilds, with Noita and Slay the Spire 2 close behind.
history: Autumn Bun first became Moderator on October 12th of 2014 (along with Frosty) and has been Admin since November 2014. She then stepped up under the Designer role on September 20th, 2023 in recognition of designing, drafting, and testing most of the custom content on our server.
